B: B takes no shit from anyone or anything and she gets on with it, having as much well-earned fun on the way within the constraints of the situation.
Babette: Rarely given to treachery, Babette tends to do things fully and completely, and her rather splendid radar means she rarely needs to deal with unmitigated fuckwits, which is handy in a world where every third or fourth buffoon has something tattooed across the side of their face. No, this girl enjoys fine wine, intelligent and insightful conversation, she's rarely paranoid, she's well-travelled and her life-desires are particular and unique, as are her close friends.
Babita: You know how sometimes you get on a ship or a large boat and you just know that the skipper, while a friendly and gregarious individual, shouldn't be in charge of any kind of vessel? Well this is a lot like Babita. Yes, she beats her chest and talks long and hard, and she's funny, but is she keeping her eye on the horizon enough to make those around her feel safe? I'm not so sure...
Babs: Rarely rushing to a decision or a point of view, Babs surveys the scene in second gear for most of the time, moving and thinking with an easy style. When she decides to act, however, you will definitely know about it.
Bailey: If she's at home then she's in her room, and it doesn't seem to matter if she's 7 or 27.
Bamba: What Bamba says, goes. She’s a mighty fun lass, however.
Bambi:
Bambi flies one of two ways. For example, her biggest problem in life is either one of two things:

1. Deciding which colour to put in her hair (or perhaps which style of feathers or dreads to go with) and which style of fairy wings to purchase for the next music festival.

OR

2. Which weapon to use as regards either her elbow, fist or foot, to finally dispatch this Japanese Kung Fu master, in her final test to become the most proficient, fast and skilful martial arts exponent on the planet.
Banita: Banita is a zesty, punchy, hop-a-long kind of gal who doesn't dilly-dally in front of the TV for too long.
Barb: If ever home alone, and it's a rare event these days, Barb' loves nothing more than stripping off, cracking a good bottle of wine and turning up the music in preparation for some delicious Nude Pizza Base Tossing!!!!
Barbara: A sensual women who has travelled the world. In wintertime she wears an exquisite woollen scarf which she tosses around her neck with the grace of movement that one would see in a stallion’s tail if at a gentle canter.
Barbel: What a bizarre and inquisitive woman! If told a joke, she will frown like mad during the telling and frown even harder while she computes the punch line. Five long seconds will pass, then she will explode into the loudest laughter you have ever heard. She's not putting it on. This is how she is. Her German/Austrian/European heritage might have something to do with it, I'm not sure. She loves her stroodle and cream.
Barbette: Unemployment benefits will never be any of her business. Barbette rarely sits around idly wondering ‘what if’ and, god bless her cotton socks, she has no compunction about asking a prospective out on a date or even proposing marriage if she feels so inclined, or to shag him or her quickly around the corner.
Barbie: Big hat, big smile and, if she’s living in anything larger than a small country town, a ton of bling. Barbie is raucous fun and a generous lover and friend. She reads neither philosophy nor science and has no need. She’s attached to Mother Earth more than even she realises, which is why she is loved by most plants and animals. Humans included.
Bay: Bay loathes loud discos and pestering men. She consumes a very healthy diet, reads more than most people and is wary of strangers.
Bayley: Unemotional, I don't think so. If anything Bayley is too emotional, too compassionate and perhaps she needs to tend to her own needs a little more than she does. Unlike many women in the Kingdom Bayley doesn't really mind if people spell her name wrong, although maybe she should? As it is, Bayley works hard, she never gets arrested and she's never the boss. Maybe she should be?...
Beany:
No, she doesn't wear one all the time, but she does like bright colours and bright happy people. You can't say her name and not be smiling at the end of it, and this propels Beany headlong into a busy, funny life which involves a million like-minded playful cats. A career: Mmmmmm.....what the fuck are they talking about?, she'll say.
Life is ostensibly a collection of seconds, and they're delicious if you choose them to be - they may very well scribe this on Beany's gravestone. 
(Although, to be honest, she's more likely to have herself burnt on a giant pyre surrouned by 300 partyers who loved her more than god, while all that wonderful Beany dust floats up into the atmosphere and covers all of us.)
Beate: Patient and never intrusive, Beate possesses a lovely calming aspect.
Beatrice: Beatrice hasn’t had an orgasm for about 15 years, not even by herself. Not that it matters, really, because she’s passed all that bullshit.
Beatrix: Woah! So what if she’s 70 years old? How many grannies do you know have their nipples pierced??
Beau: Far more interesting than her male counterpart, Beau makes decisions and follows them through to some kind of useful, positive outcome. She’s not a tomboy in the strictest sense of the word, but she’s not far off it. She definitely speaks her mind without fear nor favour and often it takes her ages for her to realise some man is hitting on her. Usually her friends have to tell her. She’s funny like that.
Beauty: What a handful. After all the booze is drunk and the partying is done on their wedding night, the real party can begin back in the wedding suite with his wife, and that's great. But his wife, Beauty, has three giant dogs she loves more than life itself - certainly more than him - and if he thought he wouldn't be sharing the bed with the creatures this night, at least, he was gravely mistaken.
Bec: Yep, smart, savvy, sexy. Bec has her shit together. And if she doesn't, well, she's killed her partner and is now in prison. Even there she's a hoot, though.
Becca: Sweet and gentle, my arse. Becca has the IQ of one of the heads of the Manhattan Project, the determination of a one ton white pointer that’s doing 50km/hr right behind you and an overall understanding of ‘the bigger picture’ that the Archbishop of Sydney would pay alot of money for.
Beckie:
So, you're on the mountain-side studying the heavily guarded compound on the otherside of the valley through binoculars. You pass them to your 2IC and give them a minute to have a look and a think. They put the binoculars down and look at you.
“It’s too heavily fortified,” they say. “The only person who could penetrate the perimeter fence is Beckie, and she’s better on her own because no one would see her.”
You agree. Beckie it is. It’s not the first time she’s done this either...
Becky: Becky is the driver in a drag car. She's little, has no fear and her uptake on mechanical information - indeed, any information that she's given - is second to none. She has very little time for romance or romantic types.
Beige: Brazenly tough while at the same time delicate and complex, Beige has a wise head and a composure which is far beyond her years. Thank Christ her parents never called her Stardust.
Bek: Bek loves being just that little bit different, but that doesn’t detract from the notion that she is diabolically tremendous.
Bekkii: Songwriter, seamstress, sex worker, lucid dreamer - it matters not. Bekkii is big in life and sufficiently unforgettable. Don’t judge her, just go along with her and make sure you’re on her team. That’s all she’ll ask of you.
Belinda: Belinda is well groomed (or at least she tries to be), she is curvaceous and she is an uncomplicated lass. Indeed, her partner might benefit from remembering that all she wants, really, is to be looked after and to be happy. So, are you doing your best to look after her?
Bell: A sleek and sexy game boat that is worth about $3 million. She can punch through most weather with ease and she spends each fishing season cruising the blue waters off Lizard Island, North Queensland, Australia. Not only is she fast, beautiful to look at and charismatic to be near, she’s extremely determined.
Bella: Like the 3rd of 4th sequel to a popular movie, she’s nice enough, funny enough, smart enough and sexy too, but original? Who cares, because Bella is often the most compassionate person in the room.
Bellamy: A remarkable firestorm. As a pure observer, her exuberance borders on pomposity except that she is maximally caring and true.
Belle: Where do you start? Belle is sweet and smooth and smart and pure (kind of) and sexy and knowing and loving and funny and shit-stirring. And there’s more...
Benita: Carefree? Not really, but she does buzz into action whenever the situation demands it, moving quickly, thinking fast, and even causing the odd minor uproar. For instance, if Benita was at a dignified cocktail party and a close female friend confided in her that she was secretly distraught because, only a week earlier, she caught her husband in bed with his secretary, Benita's face would boil with rage. She would probably then confront said husband in the middle of the party, at the top of her voice, and include some splendid finger pointing as well. God love her.
Berenice: Berenice is the name of a gazelle that all the lions know they can't handle alone. Yes, mothers are protective by nature, but Jesus, Berenice can protect the heard better than some of the stags.
Bern: If you imagine Bernadette as some kind of normal person living some kind of normal, quiet life, then Bern is the figure who emerges from the nearest mop cupboard after the former has heard of some calamitous world event where people are in desperate need of a ravishing, multi-coloured super hero, and who drives all men berserk. Nice work Bern.
Bernadette: Dots of freckles cover her face and body and she occasionally gets lost. She is, however, exceptionally bright.
Bernadine: Reclining in her director's chair at the end of a long, final day, she pulls out her sacred cigar and sucks it alight before a satisfied smile spreads across her face. True, there are more hours to be had in the editing suite before the project is truly over, but the filming went well and she feels good about it, and certainly good enough to have a small celebration at another stage completed. After all, Beth knows the journey is where it’s at. The destination is just an idea…0
Bernice: The only part of dining at restaurants that Bernice dislikes is dessert. Make no mistake, she loves the course, but she'd much prefer to eat dessert in her own home (and possibly in her own company) so she can pleasure-groan as loudly as she likes. It’s never attention-seeking, she's not that vein, but she got so fed up with being told to shoosh by wait staff that she just stopped eating out. Isn't that sad? Bernice has a wicked, cheeky smile, she is a generous and sensuous lover and the boys up here in the box adore her and want her to return to restaurants and groan as often and as loudly as she pleases. The End.
Bernie: Bernie drives a truck, or at least she did in a past life. She has a great laugh and she’s a good drinker.
Bertie: While rarely in serious personal trouble anyway, Bertie is capable of the most magnificent and surprising of comebacks. Unconventional, outgoing and with a chilled kind of sensual air, Bertie’s sole goal is to have a shitload of fun and she encourages others to do the same by constantly moving the goal posts. She’s definitely the sort of bridesmaid who, if single and feeling a bit frisky, would sneak outside and shag one of the groomsmen in the bushes during reception.
Beryl: Beryl is a happy to get her hands dirty for the sake of the farm, her children and for the local community. And that’s more than many people do in a lifetime.
Besa: Like a beautiful old motorbike with only one cylinder, she takes ages to get going (or relax) but once she does (or is) then she is arguably one of the loveliest ladies in a room. It just takes a while to get there, that’s all.
Beth:
Yeah, I know what you’re thinking. Don’t worry, we’ve heard it all before. You say her name and your head kind of nods downward a little bit, and you think, ‘Oh, maybe Beth isn’t that exciting after all.’
What a load of unmitigated horse shit! 
Beth is an incredibly sensual woman, her ‘feel’ for people is second to none, her smile literally radiates light and she’s one of those souls that even wary strangers want to hug.
You with me?
Bethan:
On the surface, Bethan seems to struggle from one odd, obnoxious situation to the next. In truth she's a very complex lass who actually invites this chaos into her life because without it she'd be as bored as a bored bird sitting alone on a bored-looking electric wire out in the sticks where there aren't any hills, trees or other birds to talk to. So, she has a glass of wine at night and talks to herself about her day, analysing what happened and how she reacted, and then she laughs aloud and says, "Hang on! I'm cool! I'm a really nice person."
She’s 150% right, of course. Bethan is a delight and all she wants to do is help.
Bethany: Nurturing. Her name sounds like good and dutiful dairy cow lumbering its way along its habitual track toward the organic dairy farmer’s shed at five in the morning. But, there is far more to her than that. Far more indeed.
Betsy: What a rip-snorter of a girl! Betsy ia always the last one to want to go home no matter how old she is and no matter what is happening. (Unless it's the hospital visit, in which case she wants nothing to do with the place. "Why be surrounded by sick people?" she'll ask.)
Bettina: Bettina is cold and complex, and not even that cold, really. She is, however, super intelligent and extremely driven.
Beulah: Hold on to your hat kids, Beulah is about to turn up and she's as timid and as subtle as Tyrannosaurus Rex.
Bev: Bev makes the sandwiches for the shearers in the shed where Ruth reigns supreme. They appreciate the food and Bev’s sense of humour as much as she appreciates them for doing a good job on all of her sheep.
Beverley: As the Principal of an expensive all-girl’s private school, Beverley knows all the rorts because she has seen and done it all before, herself. Push her and you’ll see a temper but she’s nowhere near as uptight as you imagine. She’s actually very generous.
Beverlie: Beverlie is like a big friendly dragon who springs to life if there's a bonfire that needs lighting. Sure, she looks gruff and a little intimidating when you first meet her but no way is she like that. Beverlie's presence keeps others in check, which is fine, but she's actually quite loving. Go on, go and give her a hug but be careful though, she might just scoop you and take you for a fly. Just relax and trust her. You’ll be right…
Bezena: Bezena explodes into the world in the same way that Jackson Pollock threw paint at a distant canvas. Artist or not, she definitely adds colour to a scene, be it literal or metaphoric, and her occasional irrationality is something to be coveted.
Bianca:
Here we are in the first half of the 21st Century, and here we have an example of the new generation. At a quick glance many people suspect Bianca is chaste and normal, and ever more perceive her as rather dim and self-centred, unambitious and lazy, but you’re all wrong. 
Give her a role somewhere up near the front of the wagon, where her decisions matter, and you’ll be doing everyone a favour, including yourself. Amen.
Biata: Difficult to rile, Biata's defining characteristic is that she is the objective listener. She has the capacity to think outside the box and she takes her time in coming to a solution, which is rarely wrong. Indeed, her ideas are often covetted.
Biba: Man, what a chick. Seriously. Biba is the kind of girl who, disregarding the possibility of being chased and eaten by a giant fucking grizzly bear, will hike up to a giant rocky outcrop in the Canadian Rockies on her own, camping out for a few nights, and when she finally gets to the top she will sit down quietly, cross her legs, put a flower in her hair (which she brought especially for the occasion) and meditate with a contented smile on her face. Here, of course, she will remind herself that she is a part of everything and that everything and everyone is a part of her. Back down in the real world, Biba floats along as if she were travelling on a cloud and she has more friends than she knows what to do with.
Bibo: The brilliant. The beautiful. The becalmed. Bibo.
Billee: Billee is another one of those aliens pretending to be a human inside a human body. She's actually an Intergallactic Anthropologist. Totally loving and (usually) harmless, Billee's role, here on Earth, is to perform zany and crazy acts in public and to then measure and record the response from the locals. You can try and ask her about, or suggest that you know who she really is and what she's up to, but she, like all the visitors, and there are a few of them out there, are sworn to secrecy. You can't blame them really.
Billie: “Hi Billie....how is the new...??”  (the gorgeous Billie flies passed on her roller blades....)  ..So, what did you do last ni-LOOK OUT!!....” ..Billie flies by again, narrowly missing everyone else...)  ..."..and what do you think of- OWW!! SHIT!!!!..” Billie laughs and that’s all we hear before she disappears, once more, into the sunset....)
Billie-Kay:
Ever seen those American baseball movies where the tension has built up over the course of the game, and where it all comes down to one last play. Billie-Kay is the umpire standing behind the catcher, and if nothing else she has a penchant for the dramatic. Better still, she has a loud voice.

Scores are tied and the game is nearly over. The pitcher takes his stance on the mound.

The crowd of 30,000 gathers a hush.

The hitter is 2 strikes down. The championship is about to be decided. 

The pitcher winds up and lets it fly. The ball is drifting wide but does it swing back enough? The batter doesn't take a swing.....

The crowd takes a giant, collective breath......

Billie-Kay grimaces, points to the sidelines and yells out at the top of her voice, ".........SSSSSSTEEEEEEEEEEEEEEERIKE!!!!!!!!!!"

Amid the celebrations of the fielding team, the immediate arguing and bitching in her face from the batting team are water off a duck's back. (As you can imagine, she’s never been stalked by some fucked-up ex-partner.)
Billy-Jane: A funny, intense lady whose sanity is border-line.
Bjork: There’s no point doing anything if you’re not going to test your own limits - this is the only thing the beautiful and brilliant Bjork insists upon.
Blade:
Option A: Had Blade been around in the era when women’s magazines were at their peak she would have loved it. The glitz and the glamour; the shocking scandals involving the latest movie star couple and a recent breakup; how Jennifer Whogivesaratsarse got her 6-pack model body back 40 minutes after giving birth - Blade lives for this kind of crap. She takes 4 hours to get ready just to go down the street and her boyfriends are hen-pecked to within an inch of their lives. She earns a living by uploading half naked pics of herself on Instagram et al.

Option B: A very quietly spoken and sensitive lass who is calm and loving, and whose healing centre is doing very well.
Blair: Tough on the surface, sensitive in the middle, Blair does what it takes and in a quietly determined way, even though her methods may be quite unorthodox and her dreams seemingly unrealistic.
Blaise: Her red hair and her accent are nearly always a given but she has spark, spunk and style.
Blake: Like a male Simon, no one is ever really sure of what Blake is thinking. Fortunately, she gets offered the best jobs and gets invited to the best parties because, rightly or wrongly, people presume they will benefit from knowing her. Truth is, she's not as devious as people think. But, yes, she's no fool and so long as she isn't spoilt, she's absolutely worth knowing.
Blanche: Blanche lives with her dripping jewellery at a sea-side mansion at one of the ‘finer’ locales inside Vancouver harbour, or somewhere swank overlooking water, and she’s gruff and unforgiving like that old troll that lives under the bridge and eats children.
Blayze: Aircraft and alcohol - it's a deadly mix. Has she got her pilot's licence back yet? Anyone?
Bliss: Not the most hospitable creature in the Kingdom, when Bliss says jump she expects everybody to jump.
Blithe: John Wayne, eat your heart out.
Bobbie: Bobbie can’t escape a tomboy maleness and it compels her to live a bit harder than the next girl. She will therefore try most things and snub her nose at the world if people don’t like it.
Boneka: Okay, so she doesn't live for puzzles, well, maybe she does, but later in life when her body starts to wind down she will be one of these people who we'll describe as being as sharp as a fucking tack. Interesting people and places: Boneka will always live for these. So, give her a puzzle now if you like and watch her nut it out in no time. And we could be talking about metaphorical puzzles here too, including problem relationships, weird work conundrums and general social dramas which need a clear head and fresh pair of ears. She'd make a great shrink or government advisor.
Bonita: She's not a ball-breaker and she’s not a bully - she’s not! Bonita is just determined to achieve her goals her way. Is that so bad? The world needs more powerful women, and here is one of them. Praise the lord!
Bonnie: Fruity and freckly, Bonnie metaphorically lassoes calves at rodeos from the saddle of a galloping horse and she wins prizes for it. You just can’t keep the good ones down, thank goodness.
Bourby: Independent and philosophical, Bourby plods along like a gently plodding camel. Bourby is lovely.
Bowie: Graceful and sensual inside her ‘boyishness’, Bowie is usually the most charismatic and capable person in the room, though not everyone will be aware of it. She doesn’t gesticulate and carry-on and there’s never any need. Have no fear, Bowie is amazing.
Brandie: In what is a lovely change of pace, Brandie isn’t caught up in the life’s crazy modern haste. Does she have freckles? Anyway, it matters not because Brandie is cute regardless, she speaks at you not over you and her presence eases any tension which might exist in the room. It’s funny how some people have that effect. And for those of you lucky enough to be in a position to find out, she’s almost certainly a great kisser. Who would have thought such a simple name could provide such a thing…
Breanna: Breanna, remember to read. Doesn't matter if it's real books or blogs. Whatever you think you know madam, there is someone out there who has done it before and they can help with whatever you are up to. Got that?
Breanne: Gaunt and undernourished, I don't think so. Breanne can be a tad lazy, although every time she gets motivated about life/love/work/exercise etc, she is reminded of how much fun she has, and how good she feels. Luckily, her good friends (Mia, Brook, Jess and Bianca) are pretty good at keeping her thinking - and moving. Only one question remains, really - what’s her passion?...
Bree: A rare and ornately coloured little bird with a shrill mating-call. Unsighted in the winter months.
Breeanna: So here we go again, another child whose parents were brought up on a diet of chips, cake and coke. What do you do? The irony is that their ineptitude at both spelling names and life in general has meant that Breeanna has had to grow up quick - to help look after the poor buffoons, most of all. She is therefore smarter than most around her, she's incredibly optimistic and she wants to help. It's a miracle she made it through so well.
Breeze: Heavens to Betsy, and we thought Breeze was going to be gentle and loving and forgiving! Here's a tip, if you give her your car keys on a Friday night, after she's begged and begged and pleaded and promised that she'll be responsible, you can probably expect the vehicle to come sailing in through the lounge room wall anytime between about 1am and 5am. So good luck with that!
Brenda: The Queen of Dysfunction.  (eg. You’re sitting there watching the news when you hear a noise in the next room, but you dismiss it until the strange crackling gets louder. Suddenly you remember, and run to the kitchen where you discover that the damp phone bill that you put on the fry pan to dry-out has caught on fire and, though you don’t know it yet, the entire house is about to burn down. Ironic, isn’t it? That the house burnt down because of an overdue phone bill? Anyway, life goes on, your name is Brenda and this sort of thing happens all the time. But you’re good fun and, generally, you have red hair.)
Brenna: Never unhappy and rarely uneducated, Brenna makes the world feel at ease because she's at ease herself. Fabulous in bed. Fabulous in life.
Brexxy: Sexy Brexxy. Her name looks and sounds like an out-of-whack spine being realigned. She’s compassionate, she’s holistically educated and, as one of the world’s great chiropractors, she can massage even the most stressed person into a blissful, boneless chicken.
Bria: Bria is a crack-up. You can see her listening to what the fellow, who is supposed to be her boyfriend, is telling her, with a curious look on her face. Until it suddenly dawns on her that, in a very long-winded, roundabout way, he is telling her he wants to break-up with her. At which point she reacts instinctively by either slapping him hard across the face, throwing her glass of wine at him or kicking him hard in the testicles. It's not done out of malice or anger - she's never that nasty or immature, plus she was sick of his crap anyway - it's just a natural event that occurred in the moment. And now it's done it's time to move on. Amen.
Brianette: Odd as it is, her Dad is Brian and this sense of humour runs through her whole family, whom she adores, and as a result she loves living. Ain’t no other way to describe it - Brianette is a fucking superstar who refuses to see obstacles. They simply don’t exist, for what is an obstacle but an opportunity for humour and group bonding? Exactly.
Brianna: Brianna is a vivacious girl who hangs around with Alecia, Georgia, Bianca and Maya. She goes out with a boy called Dylan, Hudson or Gabriel, maybe Tom if she is feeling a bit traditional (Ryan if she was feeling rebellious) and one day she hopes a boy with super-rich parents will arrive on the scene and sweep her away from her pseudo career, which she was never really into anyway.
Briar: Reliable and fair-minded, Briar is about as far from being a paranoid schizophrenic as you can get. Very intelligent, she shuns the spotlight and while very few are actually aware of it, Briar is one the pillars of the company.
Bridget: Her name cuts itself off like few others and, consequently, Bridget gets flustered over every single thing, occasionally fretting badly. But, she’s great to tell your problems to because she’s probably experienced most of them herself, either in real life or theoretically.
Bridie: A cross between a white dove and a virginal bride, Bridie is a modern-day Mother Teresa.
Brielle: Brielle plans and executes well. She's highly skilled at trimming excess fat from companies who have been managed poorly but unfortunately her social life exists largely around work. She could probably loosen up a little but then again, she wouldn't be as successful at her job now, would she? Perhaps a more involved sex life might help?
Brig: Picture Frankenstein, trapped in the body of a gameshow hostess.
Brigid: Way deeper than you imagine, no matter how deep you think she is, Brigid was born to get the job done under the toughest circumstances. Society seems to have brainwashed most of humanity, but not this one. She is her own cat, make no mistake about it, and her methods are therefore anything but orthodox. She's never a deliberate rebel either, but sometimes, as a genuinely empowered and highly intelligent woman, she'll often get talked about in this way. 'Fuck them', is what we up  here in the commentary box reckon about that. We love how she plays the game.
Brigit: The drill sergeant. She's good for people like Dave.
Brigitta: The kind of woman who would make a horrible psychotherapist but a wonderful astronaut. She’s very bright, well organised, makes excellent quick decisions, is happy to sacrifice herself for the greater good of the capsule/mankind and judgements about her personal safety are made using only solid logic and mathematics. (Note: her orgasms are short in duration, reasonably infrequent but very intense, so that’s nice.)
Brigitte: Brigitte dives into things without thinking and because she can't keep her elbows down, if she’s ever startled by something and leaps backwards unexpectedly, which seems to happen often, she tends to break the nose of the person standing  immediately behind her.
Briley: A set of knuckle dusters covered in white baby seal fur.
Briohny: The modern-day Joan of Arc. Yes, she’s cute, but more important than that she spends her time standing up for, and helping, others. She’d make a brilliant human rights lawyer and if she were a canine she’d be an Avalanche Alsatian, trained in the art of sniffing out buried skiers.
Briony: The name of the supreme mystical goddess often seen depicted on a box of Tarot cards. She can see the past, she can see the future and she is so ethereally magical that you will scarcely believe such a human being actually exists. Note: Like a male Nick, she has no idea about a thing called Taxation.
Brishon: Welcome to Brishon Valley, and rarely in the Kingdom does one see two large rivers flowing in such close proximity. One river is where the backpackers flock to - there are rapids and swimming, sandy beaches and quiet, protected water holes which are cool and inviting. There is even a bloke downstream who sells coffee and icecream in summer time, at least that's what the brochure tells us. Certainly, no one has drowned in it yet. The other river however is a different story, and many people will tell you this is the real Brishon. The waters are deep and dark, and it's freezing near the bottom, legend has it, but the jungles around it make it tough to get to and there are rumours of carnivorous fish. No one knows where this river finishes, and a couple of people have tried and vanished, so these days it's left to only a select few (her close friends, usually), who get to rejoice in her properly, which is a pity. So, what kind of journey are you up for today? We suggest you ditch the backpacker crowd...
Brit: Just as Brett is a dedicated blend (perhaps we all are?), Brit is a delightful mix of Nat, Lib, Stacey and Jenn.
Britt: I can see it now. The boat is anchored off the island of Capri and on the foredeck the waiter has just delivered Britt a Bloody Mary. Reclining on a banana lounge she looks serene and seductive in a white one-piece and her big black sunnies. The party was fun and though she'd never admit it, she is secretly chuffed that the married prince asked for her phone number. Will she take him up on his offer? Probably not, but then again, Britt treats life as a saucy kind of game, so who knows?...
Brittany: Brittany is the name given to the physical act of standing up quickly and cracking your head on the corner of something sharp that you forgot was there. But her intentions are noble. Perhaps she just needs to plan ahead a little better? Brittany, any comments you’d like to add here?…
Brittney: Morbid? Not a chance. Like Lola after after her, Brittney is effectively tone deaf although singing isn't her major passion. She's more of a ribbon-tossing gymnast who has so many friends she can barely keep up with them. It all stems from her level of energy, you see, which is seemingly infinite. She's make a good Emergency Department doctor, just don't give her the microphone at the Christmas party...
Brodie: The Idealist. She leaves her male counterpart for dead. Why? Because she doesn't care a hoot what others think of her opinions or actions and she's wiser than you imagine.
Bron: A sexy woman with a deep voice, possibly the deepest.
Bronte: Bronte has beautiful clean lines. She might be a little slow to catch on but she’s incredible when she does.
Bronwyn: Her hair is normally long and a luscious deep red in colour, but don’t be fooled by the cool façade. For a hobby she organises get-togethers with her girlfriends, many of whom she can’t really stomach for too long, which is why she experiences the odd petty social drama, but Bronwyn is looking for love and comfort like the rest of us.
Brook: The Female Gladiator who is prepared to takes steroids.
Brydie: The piston in the machine. She never stops - ever - she roars when she needs to and, heavens to mercy, get out of the way if she's coming fast!
Brynn:
Books are fantastic things aren't they? Without so much as setting foot outside your front door you can be transported to a 20 foot yacht and the sailor who is  single-handedly crossing the Southern Ocean, you can visit the peaks of the Andes and you can succumb to the trials and heart-break of the traders and explorers who first mapped out the Silk Road. 
Born to seek out and to discover the limits of human endeavour, both inner and outer, Brynn is the kind of woman people write such books about...
Bryonie: Like the mood you’re in after a day at the beach with salt on your skin and kisses on your mind, Bryonie is wistfully relaxed and she always seems to have plenty of time.
Bryony: Bryony affects people in the same way a flying fox ride affects first time users as they go sailing beneath a rainforest canopy. Initially, many people, and especially those who aren't great with heights, find it hard to believe that anyone could become peaceful and calm during such an ominous looking ride. Soon after they take off, however, they understand the cables and harnesses are well-tended, they can barely hear the roller whizzing down the wire, and soon enough they begin to take in the sounds and the smells of the mountain rain forest which surrounds them. At the end, of course, the waterfall finish leaves them breathless and wanting more. And this is Bryony all over.
Bub: Again, we suspect Bub is short for Barbara, or Bernice, or Beatrice, or some such name. As it is, Bub's name shoots out into the air like a clay pigeon about to be shot-at by a person wielding a shotgun. Except there's no shotgun here, folks. Bub keeps on flying, and laughing, and doing naughty little skits, forever and ever and ever. We love Bub and so should you.
Buffy:
Jesus Christ, where is she off to now? She wants to race NASCARs in the USA? Are you for real? And, say that again...then she's off to Mexico for the World Cliff Diving Championships? Holy shit! And she did what? She shot that crazy Russian ex-boyfriend of hers? Well good, he was a fuckwit anyway. At least we know the mob wont be game to come after her again. And just repeat that last bit please....next year she's entered the Iditarod? Oh my god. 
Look, if you're talking to her, just tell her to call home once in a while, and can you tell her about this bar bill from that night at the Ritz in London. I haven't got 8 grand just lyin' around. Okay, so, can you tell her that please?
